data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'aide', meaning helper. In Islamic tradition, Aidan is the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who helped him in various battles. The name aidan carries the meaning “Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose aidan usually hope their child will grow to embody helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aidan embodies the concept of being a helper of Allah. It is a reminder for the person bearing this name to strive towards becoming a more compassionate and righteous individual, always ready to provide aid and assistance to those in need, just as the companion Aidan did during the Prophet's time. It is a call for individuals to fulfill the will of Allah by serving others and being a source of light and strength for their community.
